screeningAppliesTo: captured pre-P1/P2 audit snapshot, not the repaired canonical examples
scope: Reported four repaired IDs excluded; all other active entries screened, bounded candidates reviewed. No runtime or vocabulary edits.
reviewer: single-model editorial review; not independent human language review
limitations: All 8699 records received mechanical screening; only listed items and exclusions received this single-model review. No exhaustive word-by-word expert certification.
Parser outputs, word counts, old domain tags and POS-label differences are clues, not independent error verdicts. Literal \n gloss separators are normalized before tag matching.

Registered items include confirmed record inconsistencies, product-level fragment improvements, editorial suggestions and a source-review item. Do not add them up as confirmed lexical mistranslations.
Some words have several items; status and counts are item-level unless explicitly labelled distinct records. Pending cues may overlap a reviewed issue of another kind.
Only base English example fields were parsed across the full library; hint scopes were compared for reviewed items. No exhaustive hint-example, translation, pronunciation or audio listening audit.

This generator only writes reports. Screening statistics describe the pre-P1/P2 snapshot; issue resolutions retain their P1/P2 batch; current records use the registered latest short-example after-state. Audio release and application checks are documented separately.

sources.title: Cambridge · Words, sentences and clauses
sources.fact: 句子通常包含独立主句；祈使句和功能表达需单独判断，不能机械用词数或显式主语筛选。

sources.title: British Council · Clause structure and verb patterns
sources.fact: 说明陈述句主语与祈使句省略主语的区别。

sources.title: Merriam-Webster · nice
sources.fact: 当前普通修饰人或事物的用法列为形容词。

sources.title: Merriam-Webster · lovely
sources.fact: 同时有形容词和名词用法；lovely afternoon 使用形容词义。

sources.title: Merriam-Webster · alas
sources.fact: 表达遗憾的 alas 是感叹词；另外的大写缩写另属一项。

sources.title: Merriam-Webster · ooh
sources.fact: ooh 同时可作感叹词、动词和名词，不能只按词尾或单条释义判断。

sources.title: Cambridge · News
sources.fact: news 为不可数名词，按单数一致。

sources.title: Cambridge · homeless
sources.fact: 形容词及 the homeless 的复数集合用法；例示 a homeless person。

sources.title: Merriam-Webster · constitutional
sources.fact: 既有宪法／身体构造相关形容词义，也有为健康而散步的名词义。

sources.title: Cambridge · gay
sources.fact: 现代身份相关形容词义及带 old-fashioned 标识的快乐／鲜艳义应区分；名词称呼另有使用提示。

sources.title: Merriam-Webster · sympathetic
sources.fact: 有同情／体谅等形容词义，也有形容词交感神经义及特殊名词义。

sources.title: Merriam-Webster · learned
sources.fact: 有学问的形容词义标双音节读法，同时单列 learn 的过去式／分词。

sources.title: Merriam-Webster · harassment
sources.fact: 既可指骚扰行为，也可指遭受烦扰的处境。

sources.title: Merriam-Webster · queer
sources.fact: 存在奇怪、身份相关及动词义；名词称呼和身份自称需要区分历史贬义风险与中性／积极使用语境。

sources.title: Merriam-Webster · stereotype
sources.fact: 列有铅版及刻板印象相关名词／动词义，本轮未找到把内容印为盲文的依据；缺少依据不等于已完成历史义项排除。

sources.title: Merriam-Webster · science fiction
sources.fact: 以真实或想象科学为重要内容的 fiction；作品范围和当前提示的电影用法另以本地记录对照。
